state:
**Goal `ldap`, Stage 5 done; Stage 6 (typed values) is next. Stage 4 is done except for a CA that a program supplies.** `nvs-config` reads `[ldap.<name>]` and `[capabilities.ldap]`. `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/mod.rs` opens connections (`connect`, `open`) and runs `who_am_i`, `search` and `read`.

**On `main`**: `Ldap\Connection::whoami`/`search`/`read`, `Ldap\Entries`, `Ldap\Entry`, `Ldap\Scope`, `Ldap\Settings`, `Ldap\Filter` whole, `Ldap\Dn` whole, and now `Ldap\Ad`: `memberOf(Dn|string, {nested})`, `enabled`, `disabled`, `bitAnd`, `bitOr`. The `Ldap\Ad` bodies sit in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/search.rs` beside the other filter constructors. The rule OIDs are consts there. `enabled` is `not` of the `.803` test on `userAccountControl` bit 2. The Rust test `ad_member_of_nested_uses_the_in_chain_rule` passes against Samba, and Samba also evaluates the in-chain rule: `memberOf(Domain Admins, {nested: true})` finds `Administrator` (`tests/conformance/core/ldap-ad-filters-match-on-the-test-directory.nvst`).

The text a `Dn` gives back is `tainted`, so `Filter->toString` over it is `tainted` too. A case comparing such text binds it as `tainted string`.

Server cases reach `samba-ad` (`tests/db/compose.yaml`) at `ldaps://localhost:16636`, or over cleartext at `ldap://127.0.0.1:16389` for an `open` case. `CN=Users` holds exactly three users: `Administrator`, `Guest` and `krbtgt`. Guest and krbtgt are disabled.

items.text: **`Ldap\Sid` and the typed `Entry` readers for GUID, SID, FILETIME, intervals and GeneralizedTime** (`rule:core-classes/ldap-value-types`, ADR 0278 § 8). The readers read the same lists as `values_named` (`crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/search.rs:128`), and the rows go on `ENTRY` (`crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/registry.rs:507`). Rust test `object_guid_reads_as_a_uuid_with_ads_byte_order` in `crates/nvs-stdlib/tests/ldap.rs:429`'s neighbourhood; case `tests/conformance/core/ldap-typed-values.nvst`.

**`Ad\AccountFlags` and `Ad\GroupType`, readonly objects with one `bool` per flag, keeping unnamed bits** (`rule:core-classes/ldap-value-types`). Classes beside `AD` (`crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/registry.rs:1184`).

**Ranged attribute merge and the schema read once per pool** (`rule:core-classes/ldap-value-types`, ADR 0278 § 8). The search loop is `nvs_core_ldap_entries_advance` (`crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/search.rs:370`).

backlog: A CA a program supplies for `Ldap::open` (Stage 4 remainder, ADR 0278 § 2).
Stages 7 to 10: writes and passwords, `authenticate`, the AD extras, the feature proofs (`data/goals/ldap.json` checks).
ADR 0278 § 8 is not in the Stage 6 `[context] adrs`. Add `0278 §8` there if the rule fragment is not enough.
